TITLE:
Pak PM Sharif Walks Away After UN Grilling on Hafiz Saeed

DESCRIPTION:
Pak PM Shehbaz Sharif was grilled at the UN over Hafiz Saeed and allegations of harbouring terrorism, then walked away.
He also addressed the UNGA and raised Kashmir.
